$description: Values Chakra UI does not define as variables, and contrast adjustments, for the dark mode.

fonts-heading.$value: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

fonts-body.$value: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

border-strong.$description: Contrast adjustment: Chakra's gray-600 doesn't reach 3:1 here; gray-500 is the nearest step of the same ramp that does (4.12:1)

border-focus.$description: Contrast adjustment: Chakra's gray-600 doesn't reach 3:1 here; gray-500 is the nearest step of the same ramp that does (4.12:1)

selection-background.$description: Chakra's informational tint, which is its selected-row fill

hover.$description: Chakra shades hover with separate palette steps; Polyxd needs a state-layer opacity

disabled.$description: Chakra's disabled controls are its standard controls at half opacity

min.$description: Chakra's medium control is 40px; 44px is the touch target a generated surface is held to

max.$description: Characters per line for running text (Polyxd; Chakra has no measure token)

offset.$description: Chakra's focus ring is a 2px outline with a 2px offset
